name: calendar-order-platform
description: Isolated calendar ordering platform (local-first). Does not affect the WPF CalendarGenerator app.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:migrate -w backend && npm run db:seed -w backend
